defmodule SDKCaptureExporter do
  @moduledoc false
  def init(%{output: output, owner: owner, exporter: opts}) do
    {:ok, inner} = :otel_exporter_traces_otlp.init(opts)
    {:ok, %{inner: inner, output: output, owner: owner}}
  end

  def export(tab, resource, state) do
    request = :otel_otlp_traces.to_proto(tab, resource)

    if request == :empty do
      :otel_exporter_traces_otlp.export(tab, resource, state.inner)
    else
      bytes = :opentelemetry_exporter_trace_service_pb.encode_msg(request, :export_trace_service_request)
      File.write!(state.output <> "-sdk.protobuf", bytes)
      records = :ets.tab2list(tab)
      File.write!(state.output <> "-sdk-records.etf", :erlang.term_to_binary({records, resource}))
      result = :otel_exporter_traces_otlp.export(tab, resource, state.inner)
      send(state.owner, {:export_complete, length(records), result})
      result
    end
  end

  def shutdown(state), do: :otel_exporter_traces_otlp.shutdown(state.inner)
end
